verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly document remote MCP support in both the tool-use and Responses API: point to an MCP server URL and Groq handles orchestration without needing to implement tool logic. This is first-party documented and consistent across multiple doc pages, though there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of MCP usage specifically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of MCP integration working in practice, details on multi-server support or auth edge cases.
